How do I re-key a sanctions-held payment after compliance approval?

To push through a payment held by sanctions screening, re-key it on the LoanDesk backup screen [1]. The amount field comes pre-filled with zeros, so you must delete them before typing the correct amount [1].

“When a payment gets held by sanctions screening and compliance tells you to push it through by hand, you re-key it on the LoanDesk backup screen. Almost nobody uses that screen, so nobody remembers this: the amount field comes pre-filled with zeros. Delete them before you type the amount. The approvers will look right past it, because the screen looks completely normal.”
